Package org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery

Enum Class BeanQuerySyntaxException.Code

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BeanQuerySyntaxException.Code>
org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery.BeanQuerySyntaxException.Code
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<BeanQuerySyntaxException.Code>, Constable
Enclosing class:
BeanQuerySyntaxException
public static enum BeanQuerySyntaxException.Code extends Enum<BeanQuerySyntaxException.Code>
Stable identity for a BeanQuerySyntaxException, independent of the (free-text) message.

Codes are part of the public API: renaming one is a breaking change. New codes may be added.

Since:
10.0.0
